families.decision: Whole organic produce from a named small farm, selected fresh and intact.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic; prefer the added Real Organic seal.
Read the farm sign for a small grower, growing location and seasonal harvest.
Pick whole produce with intact skins or leaves; skip mold and wet decay.
Read the organic label; a voluntary PLU alone is not reliable certification.

families.decision: Whole organic vegetables from a named small farm, with firm heads, pods or peppers.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic; prefer the added Real Organic seal.
Read the farm sign for a small grower, growing location and seasonal harvest.
Check heads, pods and peppers for firmness, split skins and visible decay.
Read the organic label; a voluntary PLU alone is not reliable certification.

families.decision: Whole organic roots, potatoes and bulbs from a named small local farm.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic; prefer the added Real Organic seal.
Read the farm label for a small grower's name and growing location.
Pick firm roots, tubers or bulbs with intact skins.
Skip soft spots, wet decay and packs that hide the crop.

families.decision: Organic greens from a named small farm, with intact leaves and stems.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic; prefer Real Organic on soil-grown greens.
Read the farm label for a small local grower.
Pick intact heads, bunches or shoots; skip mold, slime and wet decay.
Check the pack's storage instructions and use-by date.

families.decision: Whole organic mushrooms from a named small local grower, dry and springy.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic on the mushroom pack or grower's sign.
Read the label for the mushroom variety, small grower's name and growing location.
Pick whole mushrooms with firm caps and intact stems.
Check beneath the pack for slime, wet patches or mold.

organic_worth_it_by_type.decision: Real Organic produce from a named small local farm.
organic_worth_it_by_type.delta: The Real Organic seal adds a soil-grown standard to USDA Organic.

frozen_vs_fresh_produce.decision: Fresh organic produce from a named small local farm in its harvest season.
frozen_vs_fresh_produce.delta: Frozen backup: organic bag listing only the fruit or vegetable, without sauce or added sugar.

freezing_produce.decision: Fresh organic vegetables from a named small farm, young and tender for freezing.
freezing_produce.delta: For freezer batches, choose broccoli, peas, carrots or cooking greens; skip lettuce.

washing_produce.decision: Whole organic produce from a named small farm, with intact skins and leaves.
washing_produce.delta: Bagged salads: read whether the pack says pre-washed or ready-to-eat.

baking_soda_soak.decision: Whole organic produce from a named small farm with the added Real Organic seal.
baking_soda_soak.delta: For a baking soda soak, read sodium bicarbonate on the box; baking powder is a different blend.

precut_produce_tradeoffs.decision: Whole organic vegetables and heads from a named small farm, ready to cut at home.
precut_produce_tradeoffs.delta: If buying cut or peeled produce, pick it from refrigeration.

produce_storage.decision: Whole organic storage crops from a named small farm, with unbroken skins.
produce_storage.delta: Unwashed roots for keeping, with soil still on the skin.

revive_greens.decision: Crisp organic greens from a named small farm, with sound stems and leaves.
revive_greens.delta: Slightly wilted greens are the revival option.

sprouts_raw.decision: Organic mung bean sprouts from a named small farm, refrigerated and bought for cooking.
sprouts_raw.delta: Choose the mung bean variety for thoroughly cooked dishes.

produce_root_vegetables.decision: Whole Real Organic carrots, beets and parsnips from a named small local farm.
produce_root_vegetables.delta: Bunched beets have fresh tops; carrots should be smooth, without cracks or rubbery bends.

produce_brassicas.decision: Whole Real Organic broccoli, cauliflower and cabbage from a named small local farm.
produce_brassicas.delta: Tight broccoli buds without yellowing; compact cauliflower curds and solid cabbage heads.

produce_onions_garlic.decision: Whole Real Organic onions and garlic from a named small local farm, firm and dry.
produce_onions_garlic.delta: For keeping, bulbs have dry, papery skins; skip sprouting onions or soft garlic cloves.

produce_leafy_greens.decision: Whole Real Organic lettuce and greens from a named small local farm.
produce_leafy_greens.delta: Romaine has a long head; butter lettuce has naturally loose, tender leaves.

produce_mushrooms.decision: Whole organic mushrooms from a named small local grower, dry and springy.
produce_mushrooms.delta: Dry brown bruises differ from wet, spreading dark patches.

produce_green_beans.decision: Whole Real Organic green beans from a named small local farm, slender and crisp.
produce_green_beans.delta: Young, slender pods; Northern California green beans Jun-Sep.

produce_potatoes.decision: Whole Real Organic potatoes from a named small local farm, firm with intact skins.
produce_potatoes.delta: Skip green patches and sprouts; russets for baking, waxy red potatoes for boiling.

groups.title: Whole roots and potatoes
groups.why_same: Both use the named organic grower, whole form, firmness and skin checks, with beet tops and potato greening checked by crop.

groups.title: Broccoli, cauliflower, cabbage and green beans
groups.why_same: Both use the same organic grower and whole-vegetable checks, with tight heads or young pods showing usable maturity.
